title: A tooltip, a modal and toasts beside the top layer
blurb: The top layer is painted by the page, not by a canvas. A tooltip drawn by the canvas from title text, a scene that moves away behind a showModal() dialog, and toasts that are <dialog open> elements kept out of the top layer so the canvas can animate them.
question: A canvas can't draw the top layer or a native tooltip. What can it do for a tooltip, a modal dialog and a toast instead?
result: Three things, each measured in Chromium 157. It can draw its own tooltip element where a term was drawn, because getClientRects() gives the drawn boxes. It can draw its scene moving away behind a modal dialog from dialog.open. And it can draw and animate a dialog that has the open attribute and position: static, which isn't in the top layer.
